title: Values, Ethics, Morals? On the Use of Moral Concepts in NLP Research

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing and categorizing existing NLP studies that map and analyze the inherent moral biases and 'moral compass' embedded in large language models due to their training data.
Surveying the datasets of 92 papers on morality in NLP to calculate the distribution of languages processed, revealing a severe skew toward English (75.8%).

Analyzing the sources of datasets used in the surveyed literature (primarily Twitter and Reddit) to highlight an overrepresentation of specific demographics (e.g., US males) and a severe lack of cultural and sub-cultural diversity.
